title: FHGM gene-model record - draft contract v0.1 (proposal)
description: Draft native FHGM model record. Proposal under review in FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification#204: no adopted contract, no schemaVersion, no released schema URI and no toolkit support is claimed. Field names and shapes follow the released FHGFF3 1.1 objects where their meanings match (docs/FORMAT.md R15, fhgff3.json). Object-level constraints that a JSON Schema cannot express - model ID uniqueness, feature-target resolution, record/file reference agreement and predecessor-pointer resolution with the resolvable, unresolvable and ambiguous verdicts - are enforced by the separate model-level checker in validate_fhgm.py.

modelId.description: Draft (#204: model identity and scope). Opaque model identifier, unique within one annotation snapshot and stable across a revision of the same model on the same assembly. Curator versus derived authority is an open question.

modelVersion.description: Draft (#204: model identity and scope). Opaque model version. An immediate revision must use a value different from its predecessor; no ordering is implied.

featureId.description: Draft (#204: model identity and scope). Exact decoded local GFF3 feature ID targeted by this record. The v0.1 default resolves one gene row; transcript scope is an open question. Resolution is a model-level check, not a schema constraint.

reference.description: Draft (#204: reference coordinates). Reference assembly binding carried on the record so it stays interpretable when extracted from its file. Mirrors the FHGFF3 genome-link alternative: an FHR parent checksum, or an assembly accession with the supplied SeqCol digest; both forms may be supplied. Must not contradict the enclosing FHGFF3 header's genome link (model-level check).

annotates.description: FHR-family checksum of the annotated genome file, when the record is bound to an FHR parent rather than asserted by accession and digest

predecessor.description: Draft (#204: new and revised models). Immediate same-assembly predecessor: the prior annotation snapshot's file checksum with the prior record's model ID and version. Absent means no revision claim. A resolved pointer identifies a predecessor record; it never asserts curator acceptance.

annotationChecksum.description: Exact-byte checksum of the prior annotation snapshot file

modelId.description: Predecessor model ID; in v0.1 it must equal this record's modelId

modelVersion.description: Predecessor model version, exactly as recorded in the prior snapshot

contributors.description: Draft (#204: credit and publication). Supplied model contributors and their roles. File metadata authors stay in the FHGFF3 metadataAuthor field; article authorship, journal review and curator acceptance stay outside this record.

nameType.description: DataCite nameType, mirroring the shared FHGFF3 Author object

uri.description: ORCID URI, mirroring the shared FHGFF3 Author object

evidence.description: Draft (#204: evidence and methods). Supplied evidence statements for the model. These are producer assertions, distinct from validation results; the feature layer and external tools remain the place where evidence is checked.

uri.description: Location of the cited evidence, when one was supplied

methods.description: Draft (#204: evidence and methods). Computational methods: software with versions, a protocol reference, and supplied limitations or uncertainty.

protocol.description: Curation protocol or workflow reference URI, mirroring the FHGFF3 annotationProtocol role

publication.description: Draft (#204: credit and publication). Publication context of the model contribution. The article and the deposited model data keep separate, independently resolvable identities; the assembly identity stays in reference.

article.description: Article DOI, mirroring the FHGFF3 scholarlyArticle pattern

deposit.description: Identifiers of the deposited model data, mirroring the FHGFF3 identifier curie pattern

reuseConditions.description: Draft (#204: packaging and integrity). Reuse conditions supplied for this model record; not inferred from the article or file license.

genomeReference.description: Mirrors the FHGFF3 1.1 GenomeReference object: accession and supplied SeqCol digest are required; assemblyName is optional
